toolbar.description: Connection state of every external system the portfolio flow depends on.

notice.title: Integrations are not connected yet
notice.body: No adapter is configured for these external systems, so nothing is polled automatically. Every step below — placing the order, taking the payment, confirming the bank transfer, notifying the investor — is performed by an operator by hand and recorded in the system afterwards. Cards drawn with a dashed border are in that manual mode.

empty.title: No external services registered
empty.description: Nothing is being monitored yet. Services appear here once the SPM service registers them.

card.manualHint: No adapter configured — an operator performs this step by hand.

stateHints.Healthy: The adapter responds inside its expected latency and error budget.
stateHints.Degraded: The adapter responds, but slowly or with elevated failures — expect delays.
stateHints.Down: The adapter cannot be reached; every step that depends on it is blocked.
stateHints.Manual: No adapter is configured. An operator performs this step by hand.
